Evidence handoff 10/10; historical recovery 4/5; permissions and grants 10/10; finalization and sessions 8/8; workloads and native 3/6 with two active and one todo; providers and operations 0/7. Source 8af9c50398304ee69f9c3af85b1f4a52e4f2f6c0 connects retained-outcome recovery through current issuer/fresh actor, exact protected checkpoint-one readback, guarded opener and independent receiver. Migration/configuration transitions and older-source adapters remain open. Native immutable filesystem/static and dynamic ELF admission plus separate signed start constraints and PreparedStart are private admission only: no public start configuration, executable child, start permit/journal, cgroup/guardian or supervision closure. Prior admin-token publication in 43cea25 and native attachment in 53836b2 retain source credit. Old diagnostics/static-launcher constraints stay unchanged. Provider effects, authorized journal recovery, multi-host coordination, combined CA and egress, runtime/canary/Kubernetes and independent acceptance remain open. Activation stays 26/26, public actions 3/3 and F08 direct children 6/6 in 170d0ac. Counts are nonadditive, not effort or readiness percentages. No build, runtime, provisioning or tested-pilot credit; production acceptance remains 0/6.
